summary.en-US: Offline dictionary for any Wiktionary language, with English definitions

description.en-US:
An offline dictionary built from English Wiktionary. Results update on
every keystroke; search by headword, by romanization (pinyin for Chinese,
with or without tone digits) or by English words in the definitions. Tap a
result to see all of its senses.

Chinese (about 190,000 entries) ships inside the APK and works without
network access. Every other language that English Wiktionary covers can be
downloaded from the language menu; the indexes are hosted as GitHub release
assets of https://github.com/d33mobile/wiktionary-lookup-data and are kept
on the device after download.

Licensing: the app code is MIT licensed. The dictionary data is derived
from Wiktionary and is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (and GFDL); credit goes
to the Wiktionary contributors (https://en.wiktionary.org/) and to
wiktextract and kaikki.org (https://kaikki.org/dictionary/).
